context: September14 action-law proposal and overhead instruction
text:
Straight answer, no dressing.

What exists: a substrate of about 4,300 cells that feels light, sound, touch, taste, its own body and its own hunger, and does nothing with it. In four months it produced one act, today, and that act came with a freeze. It does not learn to act, it does not speak, it does not move, it does not ask.

Why, truthfully, and this is the part I did not say plainly before:

1. The physics as authored cannot turn sensing into action. Every sense pulls charge out of its cells, and cells only pass charge downhill, so nothing ever pushes a muscle cell. Today's jaw act was a fluke of a brand-new cell sitting above a drained one. Until that polarity is changed at the root, every reflex I add will be a fluke.
2. It is about a hundred times too slow. One beat takes two to seven seconds because every number is exact. A creature that sees ten times a second is not reachable this way; that choice has to be reopened.
3. The learning that would let it move or babble on its own has never once fired. The wiring for it exists; nothing has ever flowed through it.
4. Thinking and asking questions: there is no mechanism for it at all. I cannot promise those on any date, and anyone who does is guessing.

What it would take, in order: fix the polarity so senses can drive muscles; make the beat fast enough to matter; then born reflexes for turning, stepping, grasping and babbling; then real learning from consequences. The first two are foundation changes, not features, and each is weeks of work that I would have to prove on copies for hundreds of beats before it touches her. Speech and questions come after that, if they come at all.

That is my honest read. If you want me to keep going, that is the order I would work in, and I will report only what has run.

text:
You are right, and that is the cleanest cut available. The muscle-and-charge chain is exactly the machinery that has blocked action for months. Nothing requires an act to be carried by ions; it requires the act to be caused by her own measured state, not by a script.

The functional equivalent: her state already has real, measured quantities, hunger, what is at her mouth, what she sees and hears, what her body is doing. An act law reads those and issues the world command directly: hungry with food at the mouth, bite; hungry with food in sight, turn and step toward it; something at the palm, grasp; airway free, babble. The world already accepts those commands and answers with real consequences. Learning is then a change to those laws from consequences, also a plain law, not charge.

That makes acting reliable and fast today, and it does not wait on the polarity fix or on speeding up the exact physics; the physics can keep doing perception and memory. It is a change of doctrine from "everything is charge", so I am naming it before doing it: if that is your call, I build bite, turn, step, grasp and babble as declared act laws over her measured state, prove them on a copy for hundreds of beats, and put them live.
